meta.description: Standard 41 F2L cases (FR slot), numbered per SpeedCubeDB. All algs from JPerm's Best F2L PDF Section 1, mapped to case numbers mechanically (kpuzzle case-class match against SpeedCubeDB setups). Only strict single-slot algs kept: PDF algs that net-affect a second slot (highlighted there) or solve the mirror into FL are excluded. setup = SpeedCubeDB case setup (applies the case to a solved cube). Verify: node scripts/verify-f2l.mjs

sources.jperm-bestf2l: JPerm Best F2L PDF (bit.ly/bestf2l, updated 2021-08-08), Section 1
